widgets_values: A drone keeps flying a slow arc around an old stone cottage in an English country garden in warm late afternoon sun, past its gable end and on round toward the back garden.

The target video is a photoreal cinematic drone shot in warm late afternoon sunlight, soft long shadows, rich natural colour and crisp detail, filmed on a wide lens, the light golden and low from the left. [Shot 1] The cottage has thick walls of rough honey-coloured stone laid in uneven courses, a deep roof of grey slate tiles patched with green and yellow moss, a short stone chimney at each gable, a dark green wooden door, small white-framed windows with flower boxes of red geraniums, and climbing roses on the walls. Around it a gravel path runs between deep beds of lavender, white daisies, tall pink and purple foxgloves and clipped box hedges. An old wooden hand cart loaded with wooden barrels stands on the lawn, a weathered oak bench sits under a low apple tree heavy with green apples, and a golden retriever lies perfectly still on the grass, head on its paws. A dry stone wall runs round the garden, with a green wooden gate set into it, and beyond lie rolling green fields, hedgerows, a line of tall oak trees and a few soft white clouds in a pale blue sky. The grass is short and bright, the stone glows in the low sun and every surface is crisp and detailed. Close up, the stone shows every chip, lichen spot and darker mortar line, the slates overlap in neat rows with tufts of moss in the gaps, and the window frames are painted white with small square panes that catch the sky. Bees drift over the lavender, the gravel is pale and fine, and the shadows of the apple tree and the cart lie long across the lawn. The whole garden is well kept, quiet and still, lit evenly by the warm sun so that nothing falls into deep shadow and every flower, leaf and stone stays sharp from the front of the frame to the fields on the horizon. The camera keeps arcing smoothly around the cottage at the height of its eaves, turning past the plain stone gable end with its chimney so that the side wall, a small back window, a rain barrel under the gutter and the far end of the garden come into view, the fields and oak trees sliding behind the roof. The dog stays still and the leaves stir faintly in the breeze.
Birdsong, a light breeze in the leaves and distant sheep.

widgets_values: The camera keeps moving in a slow arc around a weathered marble statue in an ancient ruined temple courtyard in soft golden morning light, while a young woman in a long red coat stands still looking up at it.

The target video is a photoreal cinematic shot in soft golden morning light with a gentle haze, rich detail and natural colour, filmed on a wide lens at head height. [Shot 1] The courtyard floor is made of large worn sandstone slabs with grass and small white flowers growing in the cracks. In the middle stands a weathered marble statue of a robed figure on a square stone plinth, its head and arms broken away, its surface pale and matte with soft grey stains and fine cracks. Around it rise thick fluted sandstone columns of different heights, some whole and topped by a fragment of carved beam, others broken off halfway, their bases wrapped in ivy and ferns. Low stone steps lead up to a doorway in a crumbling back wall of warm golden stone, and tall dark cypress trees and soft green hills stand beyond under a pale hazy sky. A young woman in a long red wool coat and dark boots stands perfectly still on the slabs beside the statue, looking up at it with her hands in her pockets, her whole figure and her feet in view and well clear of the bottom of the frame. Close up, the sandstone of the columns is pitted and layered in bands of cream, ochre and rust, the fluting worn soft by weather, and patches of green and orange lichen spread over the slabs. Ferns grow in the corners where the walls meet the floor, small white and yellow flowers nod in the cracks, and the shadows of the columns fall long and soft across the courtyard. The air holds a faint golden haze that softens the hills behind the cypress trees without hiding them, and every stone, leaf and fold of the woman's red coat stays sharp from the front of the frame to the far wall. The camera keeps moving in a slow, smooth arc around the statue, keeping it in the middle of the frame, so the columns on either side slide past one another, the doorway in the back wall turns away and a new part of the courtyard opens up behind the statue, with more broken columns, a fallen capital lying in the grass and a low wall beyond. The woman stays still, her coat moving very slightly in the breeze.
A soft breeze, distant birds and the quiet of an empty ruin.

widgets_values: A drone keeps flying a slow arc around a small desert campsite with a vintage off-road vehicle and a canvas bell tent on red sand below tall canyon walls in warm low afternoon sun.

The target video is a photoreal cinematic drone shot in warm low afternoon sunlight, long soft shadows, rich earthy colour and crisp detail, filmed on a wide lens at about twice head height. [Shot 1] A vintage olive green off-road vehicle with a canvas roof, a spare wheel on the back and dusty tyres is parked beside a beige canvas bell tent with its door flap tied open and guy ropes pegged into the sand. In front of the tent a ring of dark stones holds a cold campfire of grey ash, with two folding wooden chairs, a low wooden crate used as a table and a dented enamel kettle on it. A coiled rope, a green jerrycan and a stack of split firewood sit by the vehicle. Large rounded red sandstone boulders and clumps of dry pale grass lie scattered across the flat red sand, and behind the camp tall layered canyon walls of orange and red rock rise toward a clear deep blue sky, with a dead twisted tree on a ledge. Close up, the sand is fine and rippled with the tracks of the vehicle's tyres and a few footprints, the canvas of the tent is slightly weathered with darker seams, and the paint of the vehicle is faded and chipped along its edges, with a dented front wing and a dusty windscreen. The boulders are smooth and rounded, banded in red and orange with small dark holes, and their shadows lie long and blue on the sand. Dry tufts of pale grass and a few low green shrubs grow between them, and every rope, chair leg and stone of the fire ring stays sharp from the front of the frame to the top of the canyon wall. The camera keeps arcing smoothly around the camp, keeping the tent in the middle of the frame, so the far side of the tent, its back wall and guy ropes, the stack of firewood and a second group of boulders turn into view, and the canyon walls slide slowly behind. Nothing moves except a faint shimmer of heat.
A dry desert wind, the tick of cooling metal and a distant hawk.
